notes: Step 2 of the repo's script: read every record into fixed $255 character columns (v1-v39, DSD, MISSOVER) so no trailing data is lost regardless of how many commas a row actually has. Original 'infile d:/csv/2536_bridge_conditions.csv delimiter="," MISSOVER DSD lrecl=384; length v1-v39 $255; informat v1-v39 $255.; input v1-v39;' replaced with 'infile datalines dlm="," dsd missover;' over 4 rows sampled verbatim from the repo's own 2536_bridge_conditions.csv (English header + 3 clean data rows), truncated to the first 10 columns (v1-v10) for a compact bundle. The v1-v39 variable-list RANGE shorthand in LENGTH/INFORMAT/INPUT does not currently parse on Jenner (filed as regression tests); worked around by spelling out v1..v10 explicitly, exercising the identical DSD/MISSOVER/$255 read logic.
